Real reform means slashing bloated admin costs, exposing corrupt contracts, and putting patients over profits.

Rural communities deserve care without D.C. middlemen rigging the system.

Democrats wrote the expiration into law—now they’re panicking as their own ACA math implodes. Obamacare subsidies aren’t about helping families; they’re a slush fund for insurers. Medicaid’s collapse? Bureaucratic bloat meets unchecked illegal immigration draining resources from citizens.

The Big Beautiful Bill’s $1.6T in cuts starts by axing these scams. Real reform means prioritizing Americans over corporate handouts and border chaos.

Let the subsidies expire—then watch premiums drop as competition replaces cronyism.
